timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning powered cybercrimes.
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning are conquering the cyber world at a rapid pace.
AI can speed up many processes which don't manually can cost a lot of time.
Along with this advancement, AI ML-based cybercrimes are affecting millions of people.
Let us dive into some of the cybercrimes powered by AI ML.
Deep Fakes.
Deep Fakes are false videos or audio files made using advanced deep learning and artificial intelligence,
AI techniques that can evade the human eye and even bypass software detection.
AI-based spearfishing.
A spearfishing email crafted using AI will allow hackers to target victims more effectively and at scale.
With AI, cybercriminals would generate subtle, well-informed, well-written fishing emails
that mimic an individual to great accuracy.
AI Botnet Attack.
AI-based botnet can outpow the defense systems to launch massive DDoS attacks.
AI predicts the defense site's strategies which will help the botnet to devise new ways to exploit systems.
AI-based password guessing.
Cybercriminals are increasingly employing AI to improve algorithms for guessing users' passwords.
With newer networks and generative adversarial networks, cybercriminals can easily analyse vast password data sets
and generate password variations.
Artificial intelligence or machine learning driven cyber attacks are likely to spike in the coming years.
Constant vigilance and staying aware of the latest cyber threat landscape will help you stay ahead of them.

youtube_description:
Have you all watched Alex Garland's 'Ex-Machina'? If yes, you might already know the trouble a human-like AI could bring. That was pure fiction, but we cannot knock out such a possibility with newer innovations surprising us every day!

Explore the cutting-edge landscape of cybercrime in our thought-provoking video on AI/ML-powered cybercrimes. Delve into how artificial intelligence and machine learning are reshaping the cyber threat landscape, enabling sophisticated attacks with unprecedented speed and scale. 

From AI-driven malware to automated social engineering, we uncover the emerging techniques employed by cybercriminals to evade detection and exploit vulnerabilities. Whether you're a cyber security professional, business leader, or technology enthusiast, this video provides essential insights into the evolving nature of cyber threats and the challenges they pose to digital security. 

Join us as we navigate the intersection of AI and cybercrime and empower you with the knowledge needed to defend against tomorrow's threats today.
